items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Pat Toy used to play there, Pat Toy Trio.

ctx.x: What kind of business was your father in.

My father, oh,he was headwaiter at the Belleview Hotel and then he went to the Young's Hotel and then from there he went to the cafeteria up in Boston. Anyway it was -- Pat Toy used to play there, Pat Toy Trio.
I could compare you to Eubie Blake You are one of the young men you weren't born in the South, so you didn't know anything about that southern thing.
